blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 理解暖通空調 (HVAC) 系統在製藥設施中的關鍵角色——不僅控制舒適度，更直接影響產品品質與無菌保證
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) systems in pharmaceutical facilities: they control not just comfort but also directly affect product quality and sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 掌握本指引的範圍與結構，了解它如何補充 ISPE Baseline Guides 並涵蓋設施生命週期各階段
blocks.en: Grasp the scope and structure of this Guide, and how it supplements the ISPE Baseline Guides and covers every stage of the facility life cycle

blocks.zh: 熟悉 1.6 節的 26 個關鍵概念，包括換氣次數、壓差控制、微粒監測、氣閘類型、AHU 分區等核心主題
blocks.en: Become familiar with the 26 key concepts in Section 1.6, including air change rate, differential pressure control, particle monitoring, airlock types, and AHU zoning

blocks.zh: 理解潔淨室分類體系（EU Grade vs FDA ISO Class vs ISPE Grade）的對應關係與差異
blocks.en: Understand how the cleanroom classification systems (EU Grade vs FDA ISO Class vs ISPE Grade) correspond to and differ from one another

blocks.zh: 建立「空氣品質 = 過濾 + 稀釋 + 壓差 + 氣流方向」的整體思維框架
blocks.en: Build the overall mindset that "air quality = filtration + dilution + differential pressure + airflow direction"

blocks.zh: 1.1 Background（背景）
blocks.en: 1.1 Background

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 在製藥中的角色
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Role of HVAC in Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 暖通空調 (HVAC) 系統在製藥廠不只是「讓人舒服」的設備——它是直接影響產品品質的關鍵系統。原文開宗明義說 HVAC 是 "critical system"，這意味著它屬於需要確效 (Qualification) 的對象。
blocks.en: HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) in a pharmaceutical plant is not just equipment that "keeps people comfortable"; it is a critical system that directly affects product quality. The original text states plainly that HVAC is a "critical system", which means it is subject to qualification.

blocks.zh: GEP（良好工程實務）：工程設計的基本功，確保系統可靠、經濟、可維護。
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practice): the fundamentals of engineering design, ensuring systems are reliable, economical and maintainable.

blocks.zh: GMP（良好製造規範）：法規要求的品質底線，確保產品安全有效。
blocks.en: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice): the regulatory quality baseline, ensuring products are safe and effective.

blocks.zh: 本指引的核心理念：HVAC 設計需要 GEP + GMP 兩者兼顧，不是盲目追求最高規格，而是在法規合規與工程經濟之間找到最佳平衡。
blocks.en: The core philosophy of this Guide: HVAC design must satisfy both GEP and GMP. The aim is not to blindly pursue the highest specification, but to find the best balance between regulatory compliance and engineering economics.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家手術室等級的餐廳——HVAC 就像是餐廳的空氣管理系統。一般餐廳只需要冷暖氣讓客人舒服（GEP），但手術室等級的餐廳還需要控制空氣中的微粒和微生物（GMP）。你不能只靠開窗通風，也不需要把整間餐廳都做成無塵室——關鍵是在對的地方用對的等級。
blocks.en: Imagine running an operating-theatre-grade restaurant, with HVAC as its air management system. An ordinary restaurant only needs heating and cooling to keep guests comfortable (GEP), but an operating-theatre-grade restaurant must also control airborne particles and microorganisms (GMP). You cannot rely on opening windows, and you do not need to turn the whole restaurant into a cleanroom; the key is to apply the right grade in the right place.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 注意原文提到 HVAC 會消耗設施的「主要能源」(major portion of energy)。在實務中，HVAC 通常占製藥廠總能耗的 40-60%。這意味著過度設計（over-design）不僅浪費資金，更會持續增加營運成本。後續 1.4 節會更深入討論如何避免不必要的成本。
blocks.en: Note that the original text says HVAC consumes a "major portion of energy" in a facility. In practice, HVAC typically accounts for 40-60% of a pharmaceutical plant's total energy use. Over-design therefore wastes capital and also keeps adding to operating costs. Section 1.4 discusses in more depth how to avoid unnecessary cost.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，HVAC 系統大約占總能耗的百分之多少？有哪些區域可能存在過度設計的情況？
blocks.en: In your plant, roughly what percentage of total energy consumption does the HVAC system account for? Which areas may be over-designed?

blocks.zh: GEP 和 GMP 在 HVAC 設計中如何互補？能否舉一個兩者衝突時如何取捨的例子？
blocks.en: How do GEP and GMP complement each other in HVAC design? Can you give an example of how to make a trade-off when the two conflict?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Purpose（目的）
blocks.en: 1.2 Purpose

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 的三大保護目標
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Three Protection Goals of HVAC

blocks.zh: 本指引的設計宗旨圍繞三個保護對象：
blocks.en: The design purpose of this Guide revolves around three things to be protected:

blocks.zh: 產品 (Product)：控制微粒、溫濕度，避免污染或降解
blocks.en: Product: control particles, temperature and humidity to avoid contamination or degradation

blocks.zh: 人員 (Personnel)：保護操作員免受有害物質暴露
blocks.en: Personnel: protect operators from exposure to hazardous substances

blocks.zh: 環境 (Environment)：防止有害物質外洩到廠外
blocks.en: Environment: prevent hazardous substances from escaping outside the plant

blocks.zh: 原文點出 HVAC 控制空氣品質的三大手段：過濾 (Filtration)、壓差 (DP)、換氣次數 (Air Change Rate)。這三者構成了空氣品質控制的「三腳架」——缺一不可。
blocks.en: The original text identifies three means by which HVAC controls air quality: filtration, differential pressure (DP) and air change rate. Together they form a "tripod" of air quality control; none can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 把 HVAC 的三大手段想成醫院感染管控的三道防線：
blocks.en: Think of the three HVAC means as three lines of defense in hospital infection control:

blocks.zh: 過濾 = 手術前洗手消毒（把髒東西擋在外面）
blocks.en: Filtration = scrubbing and disinfecting before surgery (keeping dirt out)

blocks.zh: 壓差 = 手術室的正壓設計（讓乾淨空氣只往外流，不讓走廊髒空氣進來）
blocks.en: Differential pressure = the positive-pressure design of an operating theatre (clean air flows only outward, and dirty corridor air cannot come in)

blocks.zh: 換氣次數 = 持續換氣稀釋（即使有人帶進少量細菌，也能快速稀釋排出）
blocks.en: Air change rate = continuous air exchange for dilution (even if someone brings in a few bacteria, they are quickly diluted and removed)

blocks.zh: 本指引是 ISPE Baseline Guides 的「補充」(supplement)，不是「取代」。實務上，設計 HVAC 系統時應該先查閱對應的 Baseline Guide（如 Sterile、Oral Solid Dosage 等），再用本指引作為 HVAC 技術的深度參考。
blocks.en: This Guide is a "supplement" to the ISPE Baseline Guides, not a "replacement". In practice, when designing an HVAC system you should first consult the relevant Baseline Guide (such as Sterile or Oral Solid Dosage), and then use this Guide as an in-depth reference on HVAC technology.

blocks.zh: 在你的無菌充填區，HVAC 的三大手段（過濾、壓差、換氣）分別是如何設定的？哪一個是最關鍵的？
blocks.en: In your sterile filling area, how are the three HVAC means (filtration, differential pressure, air change rate) each set? Which one is the most critical?

blocks.zh: 「保護產品」和「保護人員」的 HVAC 需求有時會衝突（例如：高活性藥物需要負壓，但無菌產品需要正壓）。你會如何處理這種情況？
blocks.en: The HVAC needs for "protecting the product" and "protecting personnel" sometimes conflict (for example, highly potent drugs need negative pressure, but sterile products need positive pressure). How would you handle this situation?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Scope（範圍）
blocks.en: 1.3 Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念：設施生命週期 (Facility Life Cycle)
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Facility Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 本指引涵蓋 HVAC 系統從「搖籃到墳墓」的全生命週期：
blocks.en: This Guide covers the whole life cycle of an HVAC system, "from cradle to grave":

blocks.zh: 使用者需求 (User Requirements)：定義「我需要什麼」
blocks.en: User Requirements: defining "what I need"

blocks.zh: 設計 (Design)：將需求轉化為工程規格
blocks.en: Design: turning requirements into engineering specifications

blocks.zh: 建造 (Construction)：按規格施工與安裝
blocks.en: Construction: building and installing to specification

blocks.zh: 試車/確效 (Commissioning/Qualification)：驗證系統符合需求
blocks.en: Commissioning/Qualification: verifying that the system meets requirements

blocks.zh: 運轉/維護 (Operation/Maintenance)：日常運作與持續合規
blocks.en: Operation/Maintenance: day-to-day operation and continued compliance

blocks.zh: 這與 ISPE Vol.5 C&Q 指引的生命週期概念完全一致。
blocks.en: This is fully consistent with the life cycle concept in the ISPE Baseline Guide Vol. 5, Commissioning & Qualification.

blocks.zh: 這份指引的定位就像是一本「HVAC 專科醫學教科書」。ISPE Baseline Guides 是「內科學」或「外科學」等各科教科書（涵蓋整個設施設計），而這本 HVAC 指引則是「呼吸治療學」——專注於空氣系統這個「器官」的深度知識。看病時先看內科總論，遇到呼吸問題再查專科書。
blocks.en: This Guide is positioned like a "specialist medical textbook on HVAC". The ISPE Baseline Guides are the textbooks of the general disciplines, such as internal medicine or surgery (covering the design of the whole facility), while this HVAC Guide is like "respiratory therapy", focused on in-depth knowledge of the air system as one "organ". You read the internal medicine overview first, and turn to the specialist book when a respiratory problem arises.

blocks.zh: 注意原文的免責聲明：本指引主要聚焦 FDA 和 EMEA 法規。如果你的工廠受其他法規管轄（如 PMDA、ANVISA、TGA 等），需要額外確認當地法規要求。此外，本指引「不是完整的 HVAC 設計手冊」——它提供原則和最佳實務，但具體工程計算仍需專業 HVAC 工程師。
blocks.en: Note the disclaimer in the original text: this Guide focuses mainly on FDA and EMEA regulations. If your plant is governed by other regulators (such as PMDA, ANVISA or TGA), you need to confirm the local regulatory requirements separately. In addition, this Guide is "not a complete HVAC design manual"; it provides principles and best practices, but specific engineering calculations still require a professional HVAC engineer.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，你可能同時為不同客戶生產 OSD（口服固體劑型）和無菌注射劑。這意味著同一設施中可能需要參考多本 Baseline Guide（Oral Solid Dosage + Sterile），再用這本 HVAC 指引作為統一的空氣系統設計參考。列出的 16 個標準組織也是你在撰寫 URS（使用者需求規格）時需要引用的權威來源。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, you may manufacture both OSD (oral solid dosage) products and sterile injectables for different clients. This means one facility may need to refer to several Baseline Guides (Oral Solid Dosage + Sterile), with this HVAC Guide serving as the unified reference for air system design. The 16 standards organizations listed are also authoritative sources you will need to cite when writing a URS (User Requirements Specification).

blocks.zh: 你的設施目前處於生命週期的哪個階段？在該階段，HVAC 的主要關注點是什麼？
blocks.en: At which stage of the life cycle is your facility currently? At that stage, what are the main HVAC concerns?

blocks.zh: 列出的 16 個標準組織中，哪些是你日常工作中最常參考的？有沒有你不熟悉但應該了解的？
blocks.en: Of the 16 standards organizations listed, which do you refer to most often in your daily work? Are there any you are unfamiliar with but should know?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Benefits（效益）
blocks.en: 1.4 Benefits

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「必要」vs「可選」的 HVAC 規格
blocks.en: Key Concept: "Necessary" vs "Optional" HVAC Specifications

blocks.zh: 本段最重要的訊息是最後兩個要點——區分兩類 HVAC 規格：
blocks.en: The most important message in this section is in the last two bullet points, which distinguish two types of HVAC specification:

blocks.zh: 產品導向 (Product-driven)：直接影響產品品質的參數，如潔淨室分級、HEPA 過濾、壓差。這些是 GMP 要求，「必須做到」。
blocks.en: Product-driven: parameters that directly affect product quality, such as cleanroom classification, HEPA filtration and differential pressure. These are GMP requirements and "must be met".

blocks.zh: 商業導向 (Business-driven / Discretionary)：提升可靠性或便利性但非法規要求的規格，如全不鏽鋼風管、冗餘系統、自動壓差控制。這些是「可以選擇」的。
blocks.en: Business-driven / Discretionary: specifications that improve reliability or convenience but are not regulatory requirements, such as all-stainless-steel ductwork, redundant systems and automatic differential pressure control. These are "optional".

blocks.zh: 理解這個區分是避免過度設計 (over-design) 的關鍵。
blocks.en: Understanding this distinction is the key to avoiding over-design.

blocks.zh: 就像買車：安全氣囊和 ABS 是法規要求的（product-driven），但真皮座椅和全景天窗是個人選擇（business-driven）。兩者都有價值，但混為一談會讓你為「舒適」付出「安全」的預算。HVAC 設計也是如此——先確保 GMP 合規，再考慮商業需求。
blocks.en: It is like buying a car: airbags and ABS are required by regulation (product-driven), while leather seats and a panoramic sunroof are personal choices (business-driven). Both have value, but confusing them makes you spend the "safety" budget on "comfort". HVAC design is the same: secure GMP compliance first, then consider business needs.

blocks.zh: 原文特別點名「over-designing of room classifications for aseptic processing」——這是業界常見的問題。例如，有些工廠將所有支援區域都設計為 ISO 7/Grade B，但實際上只需要 ISO 8/Grade C 甚至 CNC（Controlled Not Classified）。過度分類會直接導致更高的換氣次數需求、更多的 HEPA 過濾器、更大的 AHU 容量，最終大幅增加建造和能源成本。
blocks.en: The original text specifically calls out "over-designing of room classifications for aseptic processing", a common problem in industry. For example, some plants design all support areas as ISO 7/Grade B when ISO 8/Grade C, or even CNC (Controlled Not Classified), would be sufficient. Over-classification directly leads to higher air change rate requirements, more HEPA filters and larger AHU capacity, and ultimately sharply increases construction and energy costs.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的報價競爭中，HVAC 設計的經濟性直接影響產品成本。如果你能透過合理的分級設計減少 20% 的換氣量，可能每年節省數百萬元的能源費用。這就是為什麼本指引強調 QA 和工程師都需要理解 HVAC——QA 需要知道什麼是「足夠」，工程師需要知道什麼是「必要」。
blocks.en: In competitive CDMO quoting, the economics of HVAC design directly affect product cost. If sound classification design lets you cut air volume by 20%, you may save millions in energy costs every year. This is why the Guide stresses that both QA and engineers need to understand HVAC: QA needs to know what is "sufficient", and engineers need to know what is "necessary".

blocks.zh: 在你的設施中，有哪些 HVAC 規格可能屬於「商業導向」而非「產品導向」？能否量化其成本？
blocks.en: In your facility, which HVAC specifications may be "business-driven" rather than "product-driven"? Can you quantify their cost?

blocks.zh: WHO TRS 937 適用於哪些情境？為什麼 HVAC 工程師在設計 OSD 設施時需要了解它？
blocks.en: In which situations does WHO TRS 937 apply? Why do HVAC engineers need to understand it when designing OSD facilities?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Objectives（目標）
blocks.en: 1.5 Objectives

blocks.zh: 核心概念：目標讀者與適用範圍
blocks.en: Key Concept: Target Readers and Applicability

blocks.zh: 本指引的目標讀者明確包含兩類人：
blocks.en: The Guide explicitly targets two groups of readers:

blocks.zh: HVAC 工程人員（包括經驗較少的人員）：學習製藥 HVAC 的特殊要求
blocks.en: HVAC engineering personnel (including less experienced staff): learning the special requirements of pharmaceutical HVAC

blocks.zh: 品質專業人員：理解哪些 HVAC 參數影響產品品質
blocks.en: Quality professionals: understanding which HVAC parameters affect product quality

blocks.zh: 這反映了一個重要現實：在製藥業，HVAC 工程師和 QA 之間經常存在溝通障礙。工程師懂技術但不懂法規邏輯，QA 懂法規但不懂工程限制。本指引的目標就是建立共同語言。
blocks.en: This reflects an important reality: in the pharmaceutical industry, communication barriers often exist between HVAC engineers and QA. Engineers understand the technology but not the regulatory logic, while QA understands the regulations but not the engineering constraints. The aim of this Guide is to establish a common language.

blocks.zh: 這就像醫院裡的「跨科會診」——外科醫師（工程師）和感染科醫師（QA）需要用同一套語言討論手術室的空氣管理方案。本指引就是那本兩邊都看得懂的「會診手冊」。
blocks.en: This is like a "multidisciplinary consultation" in a hospital: the surgeon (engineer) and the infectious disease specialist (QA) need to use the same language to discuss an air management plan for the operating theatre. This Guide is the "consultation handbook" that both sides can understand.

blocks.zh: 原文涵蓋三大產品類型：原料藥 (Drug Substances)、製劑 (Drug Products)、生物製劑 (Biopharmaceuticals)。每種產品對 HVAC 的需求不同——OSD 著重交叉污染控制，無菌製劑著重微粒和微生物控制，生物製劑可能還需要考慮活性物質的containment。
blocks.en: The original text covers three major product types: drug substances, drug products and biopharmaceuticals. Each has different HVAC needs: OSD focuses on cross-contamination control, sterile products focus on particle and microbial control, and biopharmaceuticals may also require consideration of containment of active materials.

blocks.zh: 你的角色更偏向「HVAC 工程人員」還是「品質專業人員」？在閱讀本指引時，你最需要補強的知識領域是什麼？
blocks.en: Is your role closer to "HVAC engineering personnel" or "quality professional"? As you read this Guide, which area of knowledge do you most need to strengthen?

blocks.zh: Drug Substance、Drug Product、Biopharmaceutical 三者對 HVAC 的核心需求分別是什麼？
blocks.en: What are the core HVAC needs of drug substances, drug products and biopharmaceuticals, respectively?

blocks.zh: 1.6 Key Concepts（關鍵概念）
blocks.en: 1.6 Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 接下來的 1.6.1 到 1.6.26 是全書最重要的基礎章節。如果你對製藥 HVAC 不熟悉，建議先閱讀附錄 1-3（HVAC 基礎知識），再回頭看這些關鍵概念。把這一節當成整本指引的「詞彙表 + 概念地圖」。
blocks.en: Sections 1.6.1 to 1.6.26 that follow are the most important foundation chapters of the whole book. If you are unfamiliar with pharmaceutical HVAC, it is recommended to read Appendices 1-3 (HVAC fundamentals) first and then return to these key concepts. Treat this section as the "glossary + concept map" of the whole Guide.

blocks.zh: 1.6.1 Ventilation（通風）
blocks.en: 1.6.1 Ventilation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：通風的兩種含義
blocks.en: Key Concept: Two Meanings of Ventilation

blocks.zh: 通風 (Ventilation) 在製藥 HVAC 中專指「空氣的流動與置換」，目的是：
blocks.en: Ventilation in pharmaceutical HVAC refers specifically to "air movement and replacement", whose purposes are to:

blocks.zh: 帶走空氣中的微粒和污染物
blocks.en: Carry away airborne particles and contaminants

blocks.zh: 混合或置換冷熱空氣
blocks.en: Mix or replace hot and cold air

blocks.zh: 移除蒸氣和煙氣
blocks.en: Remove vapors and fumes

blocks.zh: 本指引刻意不使用「提供新鮮空氣」這個定義——因為在製藥潔淨室中，我們更關心的是「空氣的清潔度和流向」，而非「氧氣含量」。
blocks.en: This Guide deliberately does not use the definition "providing fresh air", because in a pharmaceutical cleanroom what we care about more is "air cleanliness and direction of flow", not "oxygen content".

blocks.zh: 一般住家開窗「通風」是為了呼吸新鮮空氣（第二種定義）。但潔淨室的「通風」更像是游泳池的循環過濾系統——不是為了換「新水」，而是為了持續過濾、稀釋水中的雜質，保持水質清潔。
blocks.en: In an ordinary home, opening a window for "ventilation" is for breathing fresh air (the second definition). But cleanroom "ventilation" is more like the circulation and filtration system of a swimming pool: the aim is not to bring in "new water" but to keep filtering and diluting the impurities in the water to keep it clean.

blocks.zh: 為什麼本指引選擇只使用「空氣流動與置換」這個定義？這對潔淨室設計有什麼實際影響？
blocks.en: Why does this Guide choose to use only the definition "air movement and replacement"? What practical impact does this have on cleanroom design?

blocks.zh: 1.6.2 Product and Process Considerations（產品與製程考量）
blocks.en: 1.6.2 Product and Process Considerations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 設計的起點是產品
blocks.en: Key Concept: HVAC Design Starts with the Product

blocks.zh: 一般商業建築的 HVAC 設計從「人的舒適度」出發。但製藥 HVAC 的設計必須從「產品需求」出發：
blocks.en: HVAC design for ordinary commercial buildings starts from "human comfort". Pharmaceutical HVAC design, however, must start from "product requirements":

blocks.zh: 溫度敏感：蛋白質藥物可能在高溫下降解
blocks.en: Temperature sensitivity: protein drugs may degrade at high temperatures

blocks.zh: 濕度敏感：吸濕性粉末在高濕環境下結塊
blocks.en: Humidity sensitivity: hygroscopic powders cake in high humidity

blocks.zh: 交叉污染：多產品設施中，A 產品的微粒不能跑到 B 產品的生產區
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: in a multi-product facility, particles from product A must not reach the production area of product B

blocks.zh: 「理解產品和製程是好 HVAC 設計的關鍵」——這句話是整本指引的靈魂。
blocks.en: "Understanding the product and process is key to good HVAC design": this sentence is the soul of the whole Guide.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，「理解產品」的挑戰更大：你可能每個月生產不同的產品，每個產品對溫濕度和交叉污染的敏感度都不同。因此 CDMO 的 HVAC 設計需要更大的彈性——既能滿足最敏感產品的需求，又不會因過度設計而浪費資源。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, "understanding the product" is even more challenging: you may manufacture a different product every month, and each has different sensitivity to temperature, humidity and cross-contamination. CDMO HVAC design therefore needs greater flexibility, able to meet the needs of the most sensitive product without wasting resources through over-design.

blocks.zh: 你目前生產的產品中，哪些對溫度最敏感？哪些對濕度最敏感？HVAC 的設定是否反映了這些差異？
blocks.en: Among the products you currently manufacture, which are the most temperature-sensitive? Which are the most humidity-sensitive? Do the HVAC settings reflect these differences?

blocks.zh: 在同一設施中生產多種產品時，如何用 HVAC 設計來防止交叉污染？
blocks.en: When manufacturing multiple products in the same facility, how can HVAC design be used to prevent cross-contamination?

blocks.zh: 1.6.3 Contamination Control（污染控制）
blocks.en: 1.6.3 Contamination Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：污染控制的基本原理
blocks.en: Key Concept: Basic Principles of Contamination Control

blocks.zh: HVAC 的污染控制遵循「過濾 + 稀釋」的雙重策略：
blocks.en: HVAC contamination control follows a dual strategy of "filtration + dilution":

blocks.zh: 過濾 (Filtration)：HEPA 過濾器（高效微粒空氣過濾器）攔截 99.97% 的 0.3 微米微粒
blocks.en: Filtration: HEPA (high-efficiency particulate air) filters capture 99.97% of 0.3 micron particles

blocks.zh: 稀釋 (Dilution)：乾淨的空氣進入房間，與室內空氣混合，降低污染物濃度
blocks.en: Dilution: clean air enters the room and mixes with the room air, lowering the concentration of contaminants

blocks.zh: 原文引用了 21 CFR Part 211——這是 FDA 的 CGMP 法規，明確要求確保產品的「純度、鑑別和品質」。這是 HVAC 系統存在的法規基礎。
blocks.en: The original text cites 21 CFR Part 211, the FDA's CGMP regulation, which explicitly requires assurance of the product's "identity, strength, quality, and purity". This is the regulatory basis for the existence of HVAC systems.

blocks.zh: 想像一個裝滿墨水的水杯（污染的房間空氣）。你用濾水器過濾乾淨的水（HEPA 過濾後的空氣）持續倒入杯中，同時讓髒水溢出（排氣）。倒入的速度越快（換氣次數越高），杯中的水就越快變乾淨。這就是「過濾 + 稀釋」的原理。
blocks.en: Imagine a glass full of ink (contaminated room air). You keep pouring in clean water from a water filter (HEPA-filtered air) while letting the dirty water overflow (exhaust). The faster you pour (the higher the air change rate), the faster the water in the glass becomes clean. This is the principle of "filtration + dilution".

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211 對 HVAC 的具體要求有哪些？除了微粒控制，還涉及哪些環境參數？
blocks.en: What specific HVAC requirements does 21 CFR Part 211 set? Besides particle control, which other environmental parameters does it involve?

blocks.zh: 1.6.4 Impact of Temperature and Humidity on Contamination Control（溫濕度對污染控制的影響）
blocks.en: 1.6.4 Impact of Temperature and Humidity on Contamination Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：人員 = 最大污染源
blocks.en: Key Concept: People = the Biggest Source of Contamination

blocks.zh: 這段提供了非常具體的數據：
blocks.en: This passage provides very specific data:

blocks.zh: 舒適狀態下的工作人員：每分鐘釋放 10 萬個 ≥0.3 μm 微粒
blocks.en: A worker in a comfortable state sheds 100,000 particles of ≥0.3 μm per minute

blocks.zh: 不舒適（過熱）的工作人員：每分鐘釋放 數百萬個 微粒，且帶菌量更高
blocks.en: An uncomfortable (overheated) worker sheds millions of particles per minute, with a higher bioburden

blocks.zh: 這意味著溫度控制不僅是「讓人舒服」，更是「減少污染源」。一個設計不良的 HVAC 系統如果無法維持舒適溫度，會讓操作員成為更大的微粒生成器。
blocks.en: This means temperature control is not just about "keeping people comfortable" but also about "reducing the contamination source". A poorly designed HVAC system that cannot maintain a comfortable temperature turns operators into even bigger particle generators.

blocks.zh: 人就像一台「微粒產生器」——平靜時是「低速模式」（每分鐘 10 萬個），過熱或激動時切換到「高速模式」（每分鐘數百萬個）。HVAC 的溫度控制就是確保這台「產生器」始終保持在「低速模式」。
blocks.en: A person is like a "particle generator": at rest it runs in "low-speed mode" (100,000 per minute), and when overheated or agitated it switches to "high-speed mode" (millions per minute). HVAC temperature control makes sure this "generator" always stays in "low-speed mode".

blocks.zh: 高濕度還會促進微生物和黴菌在表面的生長。在熱帶和亞熱帶地區（如台灣），濕度控制尤其重要。典型的潔淨室溫度設定為 18-25°C，相對濕度 30-65% RH。超出這個範圍不僅影響人員舒適度，更直接增加污染風險。
blocks.en: High humidity also promotes the growth of microorganisms and mold on surfaces. In tropical and subtropical regions (such as Taiwan), humidity control is especially important. Typical cleanroom settings are a temperature of 18-25°C and a relative humidity of 30-65% RH. Going outside this range not only affects personnel comfort but directly increases contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 公式與數據 Key Data
blocks.en: Key Data

blocks.zh:
人員微粒釋放率對比：
  舒適狀態 (sedentary work):  ~100,000 particles/min (≥0.3 μm)
  不舒適 (hot/uncomfortable): ~數百萬 particles/min (≥0.3 μm)

差異倍數: 10-50x

結論: 溫度控制 = 污染源控制
blocks.en:
Comparison of particle shedding rates for personnel:
  Comfortable (sedentary work):  ~100,000 particles/min (≥0.3 μm)
  Uncomfortable (hot/uncomfortable): ~several million particles/min (≥0.3 μm)

Difference factor: 10-50x

Conclusion: temperature control = contamination source control

blocks.zh: 如果潔淨室溫度從 22°C 升到 28°C，人員微粒釋放量可能增加多少倍？這對 ISO 7 等級的房間意味著什麼？
blocks.en: If the cleanroom temperature rises from 22°C to 28°C, by how many times might personnel particle shedding increase? What does this mean for an ISO 7 room?

blocks.zh: 在台灣的夏季，外部空氣濕度經常超過 80% RH。你的 HVAC 系統如何處理這種高濕度空氣？
blocks.en: In Taiwan's summer, outdoor air humidity often exceeds 80% RH. How does your HVAC system handle such high-humidity air?

blocks.zh: 1.6.5 Total and Viable Particulate（總微粒與活性微粒）
blocks.en: 1.6.5 Total and Viable Particulate

blocks.zh: 核心概念：微粒的兩種類型
blocks.en: Key Concept: Two Types of Particles

blocks.zh: 非活性微粒 (Non-viable)：灰塵、纖維、金屬碎屑等——不會繁殖，但會污染產品。
blocks.en: Non-viable particles: dust, fibers, metal fragments and so on; they do not multiply but do contaminate the product.

blocks.zh: 活性微粒 (Viable)：細菌、病毒、黴菌——不到總微粒的 1%，但會繁殖，對無菌產品威脅最大。
blocks.en: Viable particles: bacteria, viruses, mold; they make up less than 1% of total particles, but they multiply and pose the greatest threat to sterile products.

blocks.zh: 關鍵邏輯：活性微粒「搭便車」——它們附著在非活性微粒上移動。因此控制總微粒數 = 同時控制活性微粒數。這就是為什麼潔淨室的分級標準以「總微粒計數」為基礎。
blocks.en: The key logic: viable particles "hitch a ride" by attaching to non-viable particles as they move. Controlling total particle counts therefore also controls viable particle counts. This is why cleanroom classification standards are based on "total particle counts".

blocks.zh: 想像一條河裡的魚（活性微粒）和泥沙（非活性微粒）。魚很少（<1%），但它們隨著水流和泥沙一起移動。如果你能把河水過濾到幾乎沒有泥沙，那魚自然也被擋住了。這就是「控制總微粒 = 控制活性微粒」的道理。
blocks.en: Imagine fish (viable particles) and silt (non-viable particles) in a river. There are very few fish (<1%), but they move along with the current and the silt. If you can filter the river water until it has almost no silt, the fish are naturally blocked as well. This is the reasoning behind "controlling total particles = controlling viable particles".

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EU GMP Annex 1 和 FDA 都同時規定了總微粒限度和活性微粒限度？兩者缺一不可的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Why do both EU GMP Annex 1 and the FDA set limits for both total particles and viable particles? Why is neither one enough on its own?

blocks.zh: 1.6.6 Classified Space（分級空間）
blocks.en: 1.6.6 Classified Space

blocks.zh: 核心概念：潔淨室分級體系
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Cleanroom Classification Systems

blocks.zh: 製藥業有三套主要的潔淨室分級系統，容易混淆：
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical industry has three main cleanroom classification systems, which are easily confused:

blocks.zh: EU/EMEA：Grade A、B、C、D（有 at-rest 和 in-operation 兩種狀態的限度）
blocks.en: EU/EMEA: Grades A, B, C and D (with limits for both at-rest and in-operation states)

blocks.zh: FDA：ISO 5、7、8（只規定 in-operation 狀態）
blocks.en: FDA: ISO 5, 7 and 8 (in-operation state only)

blocks.zh: ISPE：Grade 5、7、8（橋接 EU 和 FDA 系統的統一命名）
blocks.en: ISPE: Grades 5, 7 and 8 (a unified naming that bridges the EU and FDA systems)

blocks.zh: ISPE 的 Grade 系統是本指引的核心貢獻之一——它用 ISO 數字搭配 Grade 名稱，讓全球讀者能用同一套語言溝通。
blocks.en: The ISPE Grade system is one of the core contributions of this Guide: it pairs ISO numbers with Grade names so that readers worldwide can communicate in the same language.

blocks.zh: 就像衣服尺寸：歐洲用 36/38/40（EU Grade），美國用 S/M/L（FDA ISO），ISPE 則提供一張對照表讓大家知道「歐洲 38 ≈ 美國 M」。本指引用的 "Grade 7" 就像是一個「國際通用尺碼」。
blocks.en: It is like clothing sizes: Europe uses 36/38/40 (EU Grade), the US uses S/M/L (FDA ISO), and ISPE provides a conversion chart so everyone knows "European 38 ≈ US M". The "Grade 7" used in this Guide is like an "international standard size".

blocks.zh: Table 1.1 是全書最重要的參考表之一，務必熟記幾個關鍵數字：
blocks.en: Table 1.1 is one of the most important reference tables in the book, and you should memorize a few key numbers:

blocks.zh: ISO 5 / Grade A：≤3,520 個 ≥0.5 μm 微粒/m3，活菌 <1 cfu/m3
blocks.en: ISO 5 / Grade A: ≤3,520 particles ≥0.5 μm/m3, viable count <1 cfu/m3

blocks.zh: ISO 7 / Grade B (in-operation)：≤352,000 個 ≥0.5 μm 微粒/m3
blocks.en: ISO 7 / Grade B (in-operation): ≤352,000 particles ≥0.5 μm/m3

blocks.zh: ISO 8 / Grade C (in-operation)：≤3,520,000 個 ≥0.5 μm 微粒/m3
blocks.en: ISO 8 / Grade C (in-operation): ≤3,520,000 particles ≥0.5 μm/m3

blocks.zh: EU 和 FDA 最大的差異：EU 同時要求 at-rest 和 in-operation 限度，FDA 只要求 in-operation（但 GEP 建議也測 at-rest）。另外，美國沒有 Grade D 的對等概念，而是用 CNC（Controlled Not Classified）來描述類似區域。
blocks.en: The biggest difference between the EU and the FDA: the EU requires limits for both at-rest and in-operation states, while the FDA requires only in-operation (although GEP recommends testing at-rest as well). In addition, the US has no equivalent of Grade D and uses CNC (Controlled Not Classified) to describe similar areas.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時服務歐美客戶，你需要同時滿足兩套標準中較嚴格的那一個。例如 EU Grade B at-rest 要求 ≤3,520 個 ≥0.5 μm 微粒/m<sup>3</sup>，而 FDA ISO 7 at-rest 沒有明確要求。如果你同時服務歐美市場，就必須滿足 EU 的 at-rest 標準。
blocks.en: If your CDMO serves both European and US clients, you need to meet the stricter of the two sets of standards. For example, EU Grade B at-rest requires ≤3,520 particles ≥0.5 μm/m<sup>3</sup>, while FDA ISO 7 at-rest has no explicit requirement. If you serve both the European and US markets, you must meet the EU at-rest standard.

blocks.zh: 你的設施使用哪套分級系統？如果有客戶使用不同系統，你如何進行對照和溝通？
blocks.en: Which classification system does your facility use? If clients use different systems, how do you map between them and communicate?

blocks.zh: CNC (Controlled Not Classified) 區域在你的設施中如何定義和監測？它與 EU Grade D 的主要差異是什麼？
blocks.en: How are CNC (Controlled Not Classified) areas defined and monitored in your facility? What is the main difference between CNC and EU Grade D?

blocks.zh: 1.6.7 Maintaining Classification（維持分級）
blocks.en: 1.6.7 Maintaining Classification

blocks.zh: 核心概念：換氣次數 ≠ 潔淨度等級
blocks.en: Key Concept: Air Change Rate ≠ Cleanliness Class

blocks.zh: 這是本指引最重要的觀念突破之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important conceptual breakthroughs in this Guide:

blocks.zh: 傳統迷思：「ISO 7 = 每小時 20 次換氣」「ISO 8 = 每小時 10 次換氣」
blocks.en: Traditional myth: "ISO 7 = 20 air changes per hour" and "ISO 8 = 10 air changes per hour"

blocks.zh: 正確理解：換氣次數 (Air Change Rate) 更多地決定房間從「擾動」恢復到「靜態」的速度（Recovery Rate），而非直接決定微粒計數。武斷設定的換氣次數可能過高（浪費能源）或不足（達不到效果）。
blocks.en: Correct understanding: the air change rate mainly determines how quickly a room recovers from a "disturbed" state to its "at-rest" state (recovery rate), rather than directly determining particle counts. An arbitrarily set air change rate may be too high (wasting energy) or too low (not achieving the effect).

blocks.zh: 就像游泳池的水循環：循環速度（換氣次數）決定的是「如果有人往池裡倒了一杯墨水，多久能恢復清澈」（Recovery Rate）。但池水的基本清潔度取決於過濾品質和初始水質，不是靠加快循環速度。盲目增加循環速度只會浪費電力。
blocks.en: It is like water circulation in a swimming pool: the circulation rate (air change rate) determines "how long it takes to become clear again if someone pours a cup of ink into the pool" (recovery rate). But the basic cleanliness of the pool water depends on filtration quality and the initial water quality, not on speeding up circulation. Blindly increasing the circulation rate only wastes electricity.

blocks.zh: 原文明確指出武斷的換氣次數設定會帶來「significant cost implications」——這包括：
blocks.en: The original text clearly states that arbitrarily set air change rates carry "significant cost implications", including:

blocks.zh: 更大的 AHU（空氣處理機組）= 更高的設備成本
blocks.en: Larger AHUs (air handling units) = higher equipment cost

blocks.zh: 更大的風管尺寸 = 更高的施工成本
blocks.en: Larger duct sizes = higher construction cost

blocks.zh: 更多的送風量 = 更高的能源成本（持續 24/7/365）
blocks.en: More supply air = higher energy cost (continuous, 24/7/365)

blocks.zh: 更大的房間面積需求 = 更高的建造成本
blocks.en: Larger room area requirements = higher construction cost

blocks.zh: 聰明的設計師會先用「經驗法則」做概念設計，再根據實際製程數據優化換氣次數。
blocks.en: A smart designer first uses "rules of thumb" for the conceptual design, then optimizes the air change rate based on actual process data.

blocks.zh: 你的 ISO 7 房間目前設定多少換氣次數？這個數字是基於計算還是「經驗法則」？有沒有優化的空間？
blocks.en: What air change rate is currently set for your ISO 7 rooms? Is that number based on calculation or a "rule of thumb"? Is there room for optimization?

blocks.zh: 如果將 ISO 7 房間的換氣次數從 25 次/小時降到 15 次/小時，會節省多少能源成本？Recovery Time 會受到什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the air change rate of an ISO 7 room is reduced from 25 per hour to 15 per hour, how much energy cost would be saved? How would the recovery time be affected?

blocks.zh: 1.6.8 Particle Generation Rate（微粒產生速率）
blocks.en: 1.6.8 Particle Generation Rate

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PGR 與數據驅動設計
blocks.en: Key Concept: PGR and Data-Driven Design

blocks.zh: 微粒產生速率 (PGR) 是一個可以量化的數值——如果你知道房間的穩態微粒計數、送風量和送風微粒水平，就能算出製程的 PGR。這個數值可以「移植」到新設施的設計中，實現數據驅動的 HVAC 設計，而非靠經驗猜測。
blocks.en: Particle generation rate (PGR) is a quantifiable value: if you know the steady-state particle count of the room, the supply air volume and the particle level of the supply air, you can calculate the PGR of the process. This value can be "transplanted" into the design of a new facility, enabling data-driven HVAC design rather than guesswork based on experience.

blocks.zh: 兩個關鍵提醒：
blocks.en: Two key reminders:

blocks.zh: 產品微粒 ≠ 污染：無菌粉末充填時，產品本身的微粒會導致高微粒計數，但這不代表潔淨室設計失敗。監測數據的解讀必須考慮製程特性。
blocks.en: Product particles ≠ contamination: during sterile powder filling, the product's own particles cause high particle counts, but this does not mean the cleanroom design has failed. Interpretation of monitoring data must take the characteristics of the process into account.

blocks.zh: 人員 = 最大活菌源：設備產生的微粒雖多，但主要是非活性的。人員才是活性微粒（細菌）的主要來源。這就是為什麼無菌區的更衣程序如此嚴格。
blocks.en: People = the biggest source of viable organisms: although equipment generates many particles, they are mainly non-viable. People are the main source of viable particles (bacteria). This is why gowning procedures in aseptic areas are so strict.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，如果你要將一個現有製程轉移到新設施，可以先在舊設施中測量 PGR，再用這個數據來設計新設施的 HVAC 系統。這比直接套用「經驗法則」更精確，也可能讓你發現可以降低換氣次數的機會。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, if you are transferring an existing process to a new facility, you can first measure the PGR in the old facility and then use that data to design the HVAC system of the new facility. This is more precise than directly applying "rules of thumb" and may also reveal opportunities to reduce the air change rate.

blocks.zh: 你的設施有沒有計算過 PGR？如果有，這個數據如何被用於 HVAC 設計或優化？
blocks.en: Has your facility calculated the PGR? If so, how has the data been used in HVAC design or optimization?

blocks.zh: 在無菌粉末充填操作中，如何區分「產品微粒」和「環境污染微粒」？
blocks.en: In sterile powder filling operations, how do you distinguish "product particles" from "environmental contamination particles"?

blocks.zh: 1.6.9 Effective Ventilation Rate（有效通風率）
blocks.en: 1.6.9 Effective Ventilation Rate

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「有效」通風率 vs「名目」通風率
blocks.en: Key Concept: "Effective" vs "Nominal" Ventilation Rate

blocks.zh: 有效通風率 (Effective Ventilation Rate) 衡量的是實際稀釋效率相對於理論完美稀釋的百分比。換句話說，不是所有送入房間的空氣都能有效稀釋污染物——如果送風口和回風口的位置不佳，空氣可能「短路」，根本沒有經過污染源區域。
blocks.en: The effective ventilation rate measures actual dilution efficiency as a percentage of theoretically perfect dilution. In other words, not all the air supplied to a room dilutes contaminants effectively: if the supply and return locations are poor, the air may "short-circuit" and never pass through the contamination source area at all.

blocks.zh: 好消息：透過優化送風和回風的布局，可以用更低的換氣次數達到相同的微粒控制效果。
blocks.en: The good news: by optimizing the layout of supply and return air, the same particle control can be achieved with a lower air change rate.

blocks.zh: 想像你在一個充滿煙霧的房間裡開了兩台風扇。如果風扇的進風口和出風口都在同一側（短路），煙霧只會在那一側循環，房間另一半還是很髒。但如果進風在天花板、排風在地板對角，空氣就能有效掃過整個空間。同樣的風量，布局不同，效果可以差好幾倍。
blocks.en: Imagine two fans in a smoke-filled room. If the fans' inlet and outlet are on the same side (short circuit), the smoke only circulates on that side, and the other half of the room stays dirty. But if the supply is in the ceiling and the exhaust is diagonally opposite at floor level, the air can sweep effectively through the entire space. With the same airflow, a different layout can make the effect several times better.

blocks.zh: 你的潔淨室送風口和回風口的位置是如何設計的？是否存在「短路」風險？
blocks.en: How are the supply and return air locations in your cleanrooms designed? Is there a risk of "short-circuiting"?

blocks.zh: 如果能將有效通風率從 60% 提升到 85%，理論上可以將換氣次數降低多少？
blocks.en: If the effective ventilation rate could be raised from 60% to 85%, by how much could the air change rate theoretically be reduced?

blocks.zh: 1.6.10 Impact of Unidirectional Flow Hoods (UFHs) on Air Change Rates（單向氣流罩對換氣次數的影響）
blocks.en: 1.6.10 Impact of Unidirectional Flow Hoods (UFHs) on Air Change Rates

blocks.zh: 核心概念：UFH 和 FFU 的房間淨化效果
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Room-Cleaning Effect of UFHs and FFUs

blocks.zh: 單向氣流罩 (UFH, Unidirectional Flow Hood) 和 風扇過濾單元 (FFU, Fan-Filter Unit) 不僅保護局部作業區域，其排出的潔淨空氣還能幫助稀釋房間中的微粒，加速房間的恢復時間。
blocks.en: Unidirectional flow hoods (UFHs) and fan-filter units (FFUs) not only protect a local work area; the clean air they discharge also helps dilute particles in the room and speeds up room recovery.

blocks.zh: 但有一個重要限制：這種額外的稀釋效果主要在氣流路徑附近有效，不能直接加到整個房間的換氣次數計算中。「短路」效應可能只創造局部的「超潔淨」區域。
blocks.en: But there is an important limitation: this additional dilution effect is mainly effective near the airflow path and cannot be added directly into the air change rate calculation for the whole room. The "short-circuit" effect may create only a local "ultra-clean" zone.

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填區，UFH/LAF 下方的空間通常是 ISO 5 (Grade A)，而背景環境是 ISO 7 (Grade B)。UFH 排出的潔淨空氣確實會幫助降低背景環境的微粒，但不能因此就減少背景環境的 HVAC 送風量——因為短路效應可能導致某些死角區域得不到足夠的氣流覆蓋。
blocks.en: In a sterile filling area, the space under a UFH/LAF is usually ISO 5 (Grade A), while the background environment is ISO 7 (Grade B). The clean air discharged by the UFH does help lower background particles, but you cannot therefore reduce the HVAC supply air to the background environment, because short-circuiting may leave some dead-corner areas without sufficient airflow coverage.

blocks.zh: 你的設施中有多少個 UFH 或 FFU？它們的氣流是否被納入房間換氣次數的計算？
blocks.en: How many UFHs or FFUs are in your facility? Is their airflow included in the room air change rate calculation?

blocks.zh: 如何利用 CFD（計算流體力學）模擬來評估 UFH 對房間整體空氣品質的貢獻？
blocks.en: How can CFD (computational fluid dynamics) simulation be used to evaluate the contribution of a UFH to the overall air quality of the room?

blocks.zh: 1.6.11 Room Airflow Patterns（房間氣流模式）
blocks.en: 1.6.11 Room Airflow Patterns

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種氣流策略
blocks.en: Key Concept: Two Airflow Strategies

blocks.zh: 稀釋通風 (Dilution Ventilation)：用大量乾淨空氣與室內空氣混合，稀釋污染物。適合污染源分散且強度低的情況。
blocks.en: Dilution ventilation: using large volumes of clean air to mix with room air and dilute contaminants. Suitable when contamination sources are dispersed and of low intensity.

blocks.zh: 置換氣流 (Displacement Airflow)：用定向氣流將污染物「推」向排風口。適合污染源集中的情況，效率更高。
blocks.en: Displacement airflow: using directional airflow to "push" contaminants toward the exhaust. Suitable when contamination sources are concentrated, and more efficient.

blocks.zh: 活塞流 (Plug Flow)：多個均勻分布的送風口產生的近似單向下行氣流——空氣從天花板向地板移動，像活塞一樣將污染物向下推。可在 20 次/小時換氣下實現 10 分鐘內恢復。
blocks.en: Plug flow: approximately unidirectional downward airflow produced by multiple evenly distributed supply outlets. Air moves from the ceiling to the floor and pushes contaminants downward like a piston. Recovery within 10 minutes can be achieved at 20 air changes per hour.

blocks.zh: 兩個關鍵警告：
blocks.en: Two key warnings:

blocks.zh: 風速過高的風險：過高的風速會在操作員附近產生渦流 (eddies and vortices)，反而增加人員暴露於有害物質的風險。這在高活性藥物 (HPAPI) 處理區域尤其重要。
blocks.en: The risk of excessive air velocity: excessive air velocity creates eddies and vortices near operators, which can instead increase personnel exposure to hazardous substances. This is especially important in areas handling highly potent drugs (HPAPI).

blocks.zh: 局部排風最有效的位置：盡可能靠近污染產生點。距離越遠，污染物擴散越廣，局部排風的效果就越差。
blocks.en: The most effective position for local exhaust: as close as possible to the point where contamination is generated. The farther away it is, the more widely contaminants spread and the less effective the local exhaust becomes.

blocks.zh: 稀釋通風就像在房間裡噴空氣清新劑，希望把臭味「稀釋」掉。置換氣流則像是在煙囪旁裝一台抽風機，直接把煙「抽走」。如果知道煙從哪裡來（污染源位置已知），抽風機（置換氣流）比到處噴清新劑（稀釋通風）有效得多。
blocks.en: Dilution ventilation is like spraying air freshener in a room, hoping to "dilute" the odor. Displacement airflow is like installing an extractor fan next to a chimney to "pull" the smoke directly away. If you know where the smoke comes from (the contamination source location is known), the extractor fan (displacement airflow) is far more effective than spraying freshener everywhere (dilution ventilation).

blocks.zh: 你的潔淨室主要使用稀釋通風還是置換氣流？為什麼選擇這種方式？
blocks.en: Do your cleanrooms mainly use dilution ventilation or displacement airflow? Why was this approach chosen?

blocks.zh: 如果房間的 Recovery Time 超過 20 分鐘，你會考慮哪些改善措施？
blocks.en: If a room's recovery time exceeds 20 minutes, what improvement measures would you consider?

blocks.zh: 1.6.12 HVAC Relationship to General Construction（HVAC 與一般建築的關係）
blocks.en: 1.6.12 HVAC Relationship to General Construction

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 不是萬能的
blocks.en: Key Concept: HVAC Is Not a Cure-All

blocks.zh: 這段話簡短但重要：HVAC 只是污染控制的一部分。實體建築設計（如氣閘 (Airlock)、牆壁密封、管路穿牆處理等）同樣關鍵。如果建築結構有縫隙，再好的 HVAC 系統也無法維持設計的壓差和空氣品質。
blocks.en: This passage is short but important: HVAC is only one part of contamination control. The physical building design (such as airlocks, wall sealing and treatment of pipe penetrations) is equally critical. If the building structure has gaps, even the best HVAC system cannot maintain the designed differential pressure and air quality.

blocks.zh: 這裡呼應了 EU GMP Annex 1 的 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS，污染控制策略) 概念——污染控制不是單一系統的責任，而是建築、HVAC、人員行為、清潔程序等多重防線的整合。HVAC 是其中最活躍的防線，但建築結構是最基礎的防線。
blocks.en: This echoes the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) concept in EU GMP Annex 1: contamination control is not the responsibility of a single system but an integration of multiple lines of defense, including the building, HVAC, personnel behavior and cleaning procedures. HVAC is the most active line of defense, but the building structure is the most fundamental one.

blocks.zh: 1.6.13 Airflow Direction and Pressurization（氣流方向與加壓）
blocks.en: 1.6.13 Airflow Direction and Pressurization

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓差 (DP) 控制
blocks.en: Key Concept: Differential Pressure (DP) Control

blocks.zh: 壓差 (Differential Pressure, DP) 是保持潔淨室空氣品質的關鍵手段。基本原理：較高壓力的空間會通過縫隙向較低壓力空間「擠出」空氣，阻止髒空氣侵入。
blocks.en: Differential pressure (DP) is the key means of maintaining cleanroom air quality. The basic principle: a space at higher pressure "pushes" air out through gaps to a space at lower pressure, preventing dirty air from entering.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數字：
blocks.en: Key numbers:

blocks.zh: 標準壓差：不同等級之間 10-15 Pa（0.04-0.06 inch wg）
blocks.en: Standard differential pressure: 10-15 Pa (0.04-0.06 inch wg) between different grades

blocks.zh: 捕捉速度：100-200 FPM（0.5-1.0 m/s）足以帶走粉末和微生物
blocks.en: Capture velocity: 100-200 FPM (0.5-1.0 m/s) is sufficient to carry away powder and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 洩漏補償：每平方英尺房間表面積分配 0.05-0.5 CFM 以補償建築縫隙
blocks.en: Leakage compensation: allocate 0.05-0.5 CFM per square foot of room surface area to compensate for building gaps

blocks.zh: 壓差就像吹氣球——氣球裡的氣壓比外面高，所以空氣只會從裡面往外跑，不會從外面進來。潔淨室就是一個「充了氣的氣球」，通過門縫和管路穿牆處的縫隙，乾淨空氣持續往外洩漏，防止走廊的髒空氣進入。
blocks.en: Differential pressure is like blowing up a balloon: the air pressure inside the balloon is higher than outside, so air can only flow from the inside out and never from the outside in. A cleanroom is an "inflated balloon": clean air continuously leaks outward through door gaps and pipe penetrations, preventing dirty corridor air from entering.

blocks.zh: 10-15 Pa 聽起來很小（大氣壓力是 101,325 Pa），但這已經足以在門縫處產生明顯的氣流方向。壓差太大反而會造成問題——門難以打開、門一開就產生劇烈的氣流擾動。設計壓差時需要在「足以防止污染」和「不影響操作」之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: 10-15 Pa sounds very small (atmospheric pressure is 101,325 Pa), but it is enough to create a clear airflow direction at a door gap. Too large a differential pressure causes problems instead: doors become hard to open, and opening a door creates violent airflow disturbance. When designing the differential pressure, you need to balance "enough to prevent contamination" against "not hindering operations".

blocks.zh:
建議壓差範圍:
  不同等級之間: 10-15 Pa (0.04-0.06 inch wg)

洩漏空氣補償:
  每 ft² 房間表面積: 0.05-0.5 CFM
  (依建築品質和壓差大小而定)

捕捉速度:
  100-200 FPM (0.5-1.0 m/s)
  足以帶走粉末和微生物
blocks.en:
Recommended differential pressure range:
  Between different grades: 10-15 Pa (0.04-0.06 inch wg)

Leakage air compensation:
  Per ft² of room surface area: 0.05-0.5 CFM
  (depending on building quality and differential pressure)

Capture velocity:
  100-200 FPM (0.5-1.0 m/s)
  Sufficient to carry away powder and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 你的設施各級潔淨室之間的壓差設定是多少？是否符合 10-15 Pa 的建議？
blocks.en: What differential pressures are set between the cleanroom grades in your facility? Do they meet the recommended 10-15 Pa?

blocks.zh: 如果潔淨室與走廊之間的壓差從 15 Pa 降到 5 Pa，空氣流向是否仍能保持正確？風險是什麼？
blocks.en: If the differential pressure between a cleanroom and the corridor drops from 15 Pa to 5 Pa, can the airflow direction still be maintained correctly? What are the risks?

blocks.zh: 1.6.14 Automated Differential Pressure Control（自動壓差控制）
blocks.en: 1.6.14 Automated Differential Pressure Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：自動控制 vs 靜態平衡
blocks.en: Key Concept: Automated Control vs Static Balance

blocks.zh: 一個常見的誤解是「壓差必須自動控制」。事實上：
blocks.en: A common misconception is that "differential pressure must be automatically controlled". In fact:

blocks.zh: 靜態平衡 (Static Air Balance)：透過固定的風門位置和風量設定來維持壓差——簡單、可靠、成本低。這在製藥業中非常常見且被接受。
blocks.en: Static air balance: maintaining differential pressure through fixed damper positions and airflow settings; simple, reliable and low-cost. This is very common and accepted in the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: 自動控制 (Automated Control)：使用電動風門或恆風量裝置動態調節——更精確，但更複雜且成本更高。
blocks.en: Automated control: dynamic adjustment using motorized dampers or constant air volume devices; more precise, but more complex and more costly.

blocks.zh: GMP 不要求自動控制——這屬於 1.4 節提到的「商業導向」規格，由設施需求決定。
blocks.en: GMP does not require automated control; it is a "business-driven" specification as mentioned in Section 1.4, determined by facility needs.

blocks.zh: 這是一個典型的「必要 vs 可選」案例。自動壓差控制確實能提供更穩定的壓差管理（特別是在多房間、複雜氣流路徑的設施中），但它不是法規要求。決定是否使用自動控制時，應該做成本效益分析，而非盲目追求「最先進」的技術。
blocks.en: This is a classic "necessary vs optional" case. Automated differential pressure control can indeed provide more stable differential pressure management (especially in facilities with many rooms and complex airflow paths), but it is not a regulatory requirement. When deciding whether to use automated control, you should do a cost-benefit analysis rather than blindly pursuing the "most advanced" technology.

blocks.zh: 你的設施使用靜態平衡還是自動壓差控制？選擇的依據是什麼？
blocks.en: Does your facility use static balance or automated differential pressure control? What was the basis for the choice?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，自動壓差控制的投資回報率 (ROI) 會明顯優於靜態平衡？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would the return on investment (ROI) of automated differential pressure control clearly exceed that of static balance?

blocks.zh: 1.6.15 Airlocks or "Ante Rooms"（氣閘 / 前室）
blocks.en: 1.6.15 Airlocks or "Ante Rooms"

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三種氣閘壓力配置
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Airlock Pressure Configurations

blocks.zh: 氣閘 (Airlock) 的核心功能：即使門被打開，也能維持不同等級之間的氣流方向。三種類型：
blocks.en: The core function of an airlock: to maintain the direction of airflow between different grades even when the door is open. There are three types:

blocks.zh: 串級式 (Cascade)：壓力從高到低依次遞減。最常用於人員進出潔淨區的通道。空氣流向：潔淨室 → 氣閘 → 走廊。
blocks.en: Cascade: pressure decreases step by step from high to low. The most commonly used for personnel entering and leaving cleanroom areas. Airflow direction: cleanroom → airlock → corridor.

blocks.zh: 氣泡式 (Bubble)：氣閘壓力最高，空氣向兩側流出。適用於需要同時保護兩側的情境（如兩個不同產品的生產區之間）。
blocks.en: Bubble: the airlock has the highest pressure, and air flows out to both sides. Suitable where both sides need protecting at the same time (such as between the production areas of two different products).

blocks.zh: 沉降式 (Sink)：氣閘壓力最低，空氣從兩側流入。適用於需要防止有害物質外洩的情境（如高活性藥物區）。
blocks.en: Sink: the airlock has the lowest pressure, and air flows in from both sides. Suitable where hazardous substances must be prevented from escaping (such as highly potent drug areas).

blocks.zh: 機場安檢區就是一種氣閘概念：
blocks.en: An airport security zone is an example of the airlock concept:

blocks.zh: 串級式：機場的一般通道——乾淨區的空氣只往外流（從管制區 → 安檢通道 → 大廳）
blocks.en: Cascade: an ordinary airport passage, where air from the clean area only flows outward (from the restricted area → security passage → hall)

blocks.zh: 氣泡式：獨立的 VIP 休息室——空氣從休息室向兩邊流出，確保裡面的空氣最乾淨
blocks.en: Bubble: a standalone VIP lounge, where air flows from the lounge to both sides, ensuring the air inside is the cleanest

blocks.zh: 沉降式：隔離病房的前室——空氣從兩側流入前室再排走，防止病菌外洩
blocks.en: Sink: the anteroom of an isolation ward, where air flows into the anteroom from both sides and is then exhausted, preventing pathogens from escaping

blocks.zh: 選擇氣閘類型時的決策邏輯：
blocks.en: Decision logic for choosing an airlock type:

blocks.zh: 保護產品（無菌充填）→ 串級式或氣泡式
blocks.en: Protecting the product (sterile filling) → cascade or bubble

blocks.zh: 保護人員（高活性/高毒性）→ 沉降式
blocks.en: Protecting personnel (high potency/high toxicity) → sink

blocks.zh: 同時保護兩側（不同產品交叉污染）→ 氣泡式
blocks.en: Protecting both sides at once (cross-contamination between different products) → bubble

blocks.zh: 在無菌製劑 CDMO 中，最常見的是串級式氣閘，因為首要目標是保護產品不被外部微粒污染。
blocks.en: In a sterile products CDMO, the most common is the cascade airlock, because the primary goal is to protect the product from contamination by external particles.

blocks.zh: 你的無菌區入口使用哪種氣閘配置？為什麼？
blocks.en: Which airlock configuration is used at the entrance to your aseptic area? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果你需要在同一棟建築中同時生產抗生素和非抗生素產品，氣閘應該如何設計？
blocks.en: If you need to manufacture antibiotic and non-antibiotic products in the same building, how should the airlocks be designed?

blocks.zh: 1.6.16 Differential Pressure Measurement（壓差測量）
blocks.en: 1.6.16 Differential Pressure Measurement

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種壓差測量方法
blocks.en: Key Concept: Two Methods of Measuring Differential Pressure

blocks.zh: 房間對房間 (Room-to-Room)：直接測量兩個相鄰房間之間的壓差。簡單直觀，但在大型設施中需要大量感測器，且會產生累積誤差。
blocks.en: Room-to-room: directly measuring the differential pressure between two adjacent rooms. Simple and intuitive, but in a large facility it needs many sensors and produces cumulative error.

blocks.zh: 房間對共同參考點 (Room-to-Common Reference)：所有房間都測量相對於同一個參考點的壓力，再計算房間之間的壓差。感測器數量少，且避免累積誤差。
blocks.en: Room-to-common reference: measuring the pressure of every room relative to the same reference point and then calculating the differential pressure between rooms. It needs fewer sensors and avoids cumulative error.

blocks.zh: 理想的參考點應該體積大、開口少、與外界壓力關係穩定——例如一個密封良好的大型走廊或技術夾層。
blocks.en: An ideal reference point should have a large volume, few openings and a stable pressure relationship with the outside, for example a well-sealed large corridor or a technical interstitial space.

blocks.zh: 大型 CDMO 設施通常選擇共同參考點方法。想像你有 50 個房間，如果用房間對房間的方法，可能需要上百個感測器；用共同參考點方法，只需要 50 個感測器加一個參考管路。更重要的是，共同參考點方法避免了「A 到 B 壓差」加上「B 到 C 壓差」可能不等於「A 到 C 壓差」的累積誤差問題。
blocks.en: Large CDMO facilities usually choose the common reference method. Imagine you have 50 rooms: with the room-to-room method you might need over a hundred sensors, while with the common reference method you need only 50 sensors plus one reference line. More importantly, the common reference method avoids the cumulative error problem where the "A-to-B differential pressure" plus the "B-to-C differential pressure" may not equal the "A-to-C differential pressure".

blocks.zh: 你的設施使用哪種壓差測量方法？如果要擴建新的生產區域，會選擇哪種方法？
blocks.en: Which differential pressure measurement method does your facility use? If you were to expand into a new production area, which method would you choose?

blocks.zh: 1.6.17 HVAC Controls and Monitoring（HVAC 控制與監測）
blocks.en: 1.6.17 HVAC Controls and Monitoring

blocks.zh: 核心概念：監測系統架構
blocks.en: Key Concept: Monitoring System Architecture

blocks.zh: HVAC 監測有兩種常見架構：
blocks.en: There are two common HVAC monitoring architectures:

blocks.zh: 整合式：BMS/BAS 同時負責控制和 GMP 數據記錄。簡單但需要整個系統通過確效 (Qualification)。
blocks.en: Integrated: the BMS/BAS handles both control and GMP data recording. Simple, but the entire system needs to be qualified.

blocks.zh: 分離式：HVAC 控制和 GMP 監測使用獨立系統。HVAC 控制系統只管「控制」，獨立的監測系統負責「記錄、報警、數據管理」。更靈活但更複雜。
blocks.en: Separated: HVAC control and GMP monitoring use independent systems. The HVAC control system only handles "control", while the independent monitoring system handles "recording, alarms and data management". More flexible but more complex.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：「關鍵參數」的監測系統需要確效；「非關鍵參數」的控制系統只需 GEP。
blocks.en: Key principle: the monitoring system for "critical parameters" needs to be qualified; the control system for "non-critical parameters" only needs GEP.

blocks.zh: BMS/BAS 作為 GMP「品質紀錄系統」(system of record) 時，必須符合 21 CFR Part 11（電子記錄/電子簽名）和 EU GMP Annex 11（電腦化系統）的要求。這包括審計追蹤、數據完整性 (Data Integrity)、存取控制等。很多舊設施的 BMS 不具備這些功能，需要升級或搭配獨立的監測系統。
blocks.en: When a BMS/BAS serves as the GMP "system of record", it must meet the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic records/electronic signatures) and EU GMP Annex 11 (computerised systems). This includes audit trails, data integrity and access control. The BMS in many older facilities lacks these functions and needs to be upgraded or combined with an independent monitoring system.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶稽核時經常會問：「你的環境監測數據是從哪個系統出來的？這個系統有沒有通過確效？審計追蹤完整嗎？」如果 BMS 同時是 GMP 紀錄系統，它就需要通過 CSV (Computer System Validation)。選擇架構時，要考慮確效成本和日後的系統維護負擔。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, client audits often ask: "Which system do your environmental monitoring data come from? Has that system been qualified? Is the audit trail complete?" If the BMS is also the GMP record system, it needs to go through CSV (computer system validation). When choosing an architecture, consider the validation cost and the ongoing system maintenance burden.

blocks.zh: 你的設施使用整合式還是分離式的監測架構？每種方式的優缺點是什麼？
blocks.en: Does your facility use an integrated or a separated monitoring architecture? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: 如果 BMS/BAS 是 GMP 紀錄系統，它需要滿足哪些 Data Integrity 要求？
blocks.en: If the BMS/BAS is a GMP record system, what data integrity requirements does it need to meet?

blocks.zh: 1.6.18 Alarm Time Delays（報警時間延遲）
blocks.en: 1.6.18 Alarm Time Delays

blocks.zh: 核心概念：避免干擾報警 (Nuisance Alarms)
blocks.en: Key Concept: Avoiding Nuisance Alarms

blocks.zh: 每次開門時壓差都會暫時歸零——如果沒有報警延遲，系統每天會產生數百次「假報警」。報警延遲的設定需要平衡兩個需求：
blocks.en: Every time a door is opened, the differential pressure temporarily drops to zero. Without an alarm delay, the system would generate hundreds of "false alarms" every day. The alarm delay setting must balance two needs:

blocks.zh: 夠長：允許正常開門通過（通常 15-30 秒）
blocks.en: Long enough: to allow normal door openings and passage (usually 15-30 seconds)

blocks.zh: 不能太長：否則真正的壓差異常也會被忽略
blocks.en: Not too long: otherwise genuine differential pressure excursions will also be ignored

blocks.zh: 報警延遲的設定值應該在 URS 和設計階段就定義，並在確效中驗證。EU GMP Annex 1 要求壓差偏移必須被記錄和調查——如果延遲設定不當，可能導致大量偏差記錄，或更糟的是，漏掉真正的壓差失敗。
blocks.en: The alarm delay setting should be defined in the URS and design stage and verified during qualification. EU GMP Annex 1 requires that differential pressure excursions be recorded and investigated. If the delay is set improperly, it may lead to large numbers of deviation records or, worse, miss a genuine differential pressure failure.

blocks.zh: 你的設施壓差報警延遲設定為多少秒？這個設定的依據是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the differential pressure alarm delay set to in your facility, in seconds? What is the basis for this setting?

blocks.zh: 1.6.19 Time Weighted Averaging（時間加權平均）
blocks.en: 1.6.19 Time Weighted Averaging

blocks.zh: 核心概念：信號濾波
blocks.en: Key Concept: Signal Filtering

blocks.zh: 時間加權平均 (Time Weighted Average) 是處理「雜訊」信號的標準方法。風量測量信號通常會快速波動——如果用瞬時值報警，會產生大量假報警。
blocks.en: Time weighted averaging is the standard method for handling "noisy" signals. Airflow measurement signals usually fluctuate rapidly, and alarming on instantaneous values would produce large numbers of false alarms.

blocks.zh: 建議滾動平均窗口：4-10 秒——足以過濾雜訊，但不會錯過真正的故障事件。
blocks.en: Recommended rolling average window: 4-10 seconds, enough to filter out noise without missing a genuine failure event.

blocks.zh: 滾動平均窗口的設定也需要文件化和驗證。太短（<4 秒）無法有效濾波，太長（>30 秒）可能掩蓋真正的異常。在確效過程中，應該測試滾動平均能否在模擬的故障情境中觸發報警。
blocks.en: The rolling average window setting also needs to be documented and verified. Too short (<4 seconds) and it cannot filter effectively; too long (>30 seconds) and it may mask genuine abnormalities. During qualification, you should test whether the rolling average triggers an alarm in simulated failure scenarios.

blocks.zh: 你的 HVAC 控制系統使用什麼樣的信號濾波方法？滾動平均的窗口設定是多少？
blocks.en: What signal filtering method does your HVAC control system use? What is the rolling average window setting?

blocks.zh: 1.6.20 Airborne Particle Monitoring（空氣微粒監測）
blocks.en: 1.6.20 Airborne Particle Monitoring

blocks.zh: 核心概念：從定期監測到連續監測
blocks.en: Key Concept: From Periodic to Continuous Monitoring

blocks.zh: 微粒監測 (Particle Monitoring) 的演進趨勢：
blocks.en: The evolution trend in particle monitoring:

blocks.zh: 傳統做法：每個生產班次定期採樣（如每 4 小時一次）
blocks.en: Traditional practice: periodic sampling in each production shift (for example, once every 4 hours)

blocks.zh: 現代趨勢：安裝連續監測系統，提供即時數據
blocks.en: Modern trend: installing continuous monitoring systems that provide real-time data

blocks.zh: 連續監測的優勢：更好地理解製程、支持減少其他測試頻率、確保持續的控制水平。但投資成本較高。
blocks.en: Advantages of continuous monitoring: better understanding of the process, support for reducing the frequency of other tests, and assurance of a sustained level of control. But the investment cost is higher.

blocks.zh: 2017 年修訂的 EU GMP Annex 1（2023 年生效）對連續微粒監測的要求更加明確，特別是 Grade A/B 區域。如果你的設施要服務歐洲市場，連續監測已經接近「必要」而非「可選」。ISO 14644-3 也提供了監測方法的詳細指導。
blocks.en: The revision of EU GMP Annex 1 (revised draft in 2017, effective in 2023) is more explicit about continuous particle monitoring, especially for Grade A/B areas. If your facility serves the European market, continuous monitoring is close to "necessary" rather than "optional". ISO 14644-3 also provides detailed guidance on monitoring methods.

blocks.zh: 你的設施目前使用定期監測還是連續監測？如果要升級到連續監測，需要多少投資？
blocks.en: Does your facility currently use periodic or continuous monitoring? If you were to upgrade to continuous monitoring, how much investment would be needed?

blocks.zh: 連續監測數據如何幫助你發現 HVAC 系統的潛在問題？
blocks.en: How can continuous monitoring data help you detect potential problems in the HVAC system?

blocks.zh: 1.6.21 Air Handling Unit Zoning（空氣處理機組分區）
blocks.en: 1.6.21 Air Handling Unit Zoning

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AHU 分區策略
blocks.en: Key Concept: AHU Zoning Strategy

blocks.zh: 空氣處理機組 (AHU, Air Handling Unit) 的分區原則：
blocks.en: Principles for zoning an air handling unit (AHU):

blocks.zh: 相同製程類型的區域共用一台 AHU（如所有壓片間共用一台）
blocks.en: Areas with the same process type share one AHU (for example, all tableting rooms share one)

blocks.zh: 相同潔淨度等級的區域共用一台 AHU（如所有 ISO 7 區域）
blocks.en: Areas of the same cleanliness grade share one AHU (for example, all ISO 7 areas)

blocks.zh: 分區決策基於產品和操作員的風險評估
blocks.en: Zoning decisions are based on risk assessment of the product and the operators

blocks.zh: 不同產品的生產區域不應共用同一台 AHU（除非有回風 HEPA 過濾），以防止交叉污染。
blocks.en: Production areas for different products should not share the same AHU (unless return air is HEPA-filtered), to prevent cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: AHU 分區就像餐廳的廚房通風系統——中式炒菜區和西式烘焙區應該各自獨立的排油煙系統，否則炒菜的油煙會影響蛋糕的品質。同理，高粉塵的壓片區和無菌充填區絕對不能共用 AHU。
blocks.en: AHU zoning is like a restaurant's kitchen ventilation: the Chinese stir-fry area and the Western baking area should each have an independent exhaust hood system, otherwise the stir-fry fumes will affect the quality of the cakes. Likewise, a high-dust tableting area and a sterile filling area must never share an AHU.

blocks.zh: 你的設施有幾台 AHU？各自服務哪些區域？分區邏輯是否合理？
blocks.en: How many AHUs does your facility have? Which areas does each serve? Is the zoning logic sound?

blocks.zh: 如果需要在現有設施中增加一條新的生產線，AHU 分區需要如何調整？
blocks.en: If you need to add a new production line in an existing facility, how would the AHU zoning need to be adjusted?

blocks.zh: 1.6.22 Use of Air Handling Units in Parallel or Series（並聯與串聯 AHU）
blocks.en: 1.6.22 Use of Air Handling Units in Parallel or Series

blocks.zh: 核心概念：串聯 vs 並聯 AHU
blocks.en: Key Concept: Series vs Parallel AHUs

blocks.zh: 串聯 (Series)：一台 AHU 預處理外氣（MAU, Makeup Air Unit），再送給下游的局部 AHU 做精細調節。常見於需要額外壓力來克服 HEPA 濾網壓降的系統。
blocks.en: Series: one AHU pre-conditions outside air (a MAU, makeup air unit) and then supplies downstream local AHUs for fine adjustment. Common in systems that need extra pressure to overcome the pressure drop of HEPA filters.

blocks.zh: 並聯 (Parallel)：多台 AHU 同時服務同一大區域。提供冗餘——一台故障時，其他台仍能維持基本條件。常用於倉庫和大型研究室。
blocks.en: Parallel: multiple AHUs serve the same large area at the same time. This provides redundancy: when one fails, the others can still maintain basic conditions. Commonly used in warehouses and large laboratories.

blocks.zh: 並聯 AHU 的冗餘設計在製藥業中是一項「商業導向」的決策——不是 GMP 要求，但對於不能停機的關鍵生產區域（如細胞培養區），冗餘 AHU 可以避免因 HVAC 故障導致的批次損失。一批生物製劑的價值可能高達數千萬甚至上億元，相比之下一台備用 AHU 的成本微不足道。
blocks.en: Redundant design with parallel AHUs is a "business-driven" decision in the pharmaceutical industry: it is not a GMP requirement, but for critical production areas that cannot be shut down (such as cell culture areas), a redundant AHU can avoid batch loss caused by HVAC failure. A batch of biologics may be worth tens of millions or even hundreds of millions, so the cost of a standby AHU is negligible by comparison.

blocks.zh: 你的設施有沒有使用串聯或並聯 AHU 的配置？如果 AHU 故障，備援計畫是什麼？
blocks.en: Does your facility use series or parallel AHU configurations? If an AHU fails, what is the backup plan?

blocks.zh: 1.6.23 Psychrometrics（空氣濕度學）
blocks.en: 1.6.23 Psychrometrics

blocks.zh: 核心概念：空氣濕度學四大概念
blocks.en: Key Concept: Four Core Psychrometric Concepts

blocks.zh: 顯熱 (Sensible Heat)：你能感覺到的溫度變化——暖氣讓空氣變熱，冷氣讓空氣變冷。
blocks.en: Sensible heat: temperature change you can feel; heating makes the air hotter and cooling makes it colder.

blocks.zh: 潛熱 (Latent Heat)：加濕或除濕時消耗/釋放的能量——溫度不變，但濕度改變。
blocks.en: Latent heat: energy consumed or released during humidification or dehumidification; the temperature stays the same but the humidity changes.

blocks.zh: 相對濕度 (RH)：空氣中實際含水量 / 最大可含水量 × 100%
blocks.en: Relative humidity (RH): actual moisture content of the air / maximum moisture the air can hold × 100%

blocks.zh: 露點溫度 (Dew Point)：空氣中水蒸氣開始凝結的溫度。如果管路或設備表面溫度低於露點，就會「出汗」（凝結）。
blocks.en: Dew point: the temperature at which water vapor in the air begins to condense. If the surface temperature of ductwork or equipment is below the dew point, it will "sweat" (condense).

blocks.zh: 顯熱就像燒水——水溫從 20°C 升到 80°C，你可以測量到溫度變化。潛熱就像水變成蒸汽——水在 100°C 持續吸收大量熱能但溫度不再上升，這些能量用來改變水的狀態（液態→氣態）。同樣地，在 HVAC 系統中，冷卻盤管需要同時處理顯熱（降溫）和潛熱（除濕），能源消耗比你以為的更大。
blocks.en: Sensible heat is like heating water: as the water goes from 20°C to 80°C, you can measure the temperature change. Latent heat is like water turning into steam: at 100°C the water keeps absorbing large amounts of heat but the temperature no longer rises, because the energy is used to change the state of the water (liquid → gas). Likewise, in an HVAC system the cooling coil must handle both sensible heat (cooling) and latent heat (dehumidification), so the energy consumption is greater than you might think.

blocks.zh: 在台灣等高濕度地區，HVAC 系統的除濕（潛熱處理）能耗可能占總 HVAC 能耗的 40% 以上。露點控制尤其重要——如果冷卻水管或風管表面溫度低於露點，凝結水會滴落到潔淨室內，造成微生物污染風險。
blocks.en: In high-humidity regions such as Taiwan, dehumidification (latent heat treatment) may account for more than 40% of total HVAC energy consumption. Dew point control is especially important: if the surface temperature of chilled water pipes or ducts is below the dew point, condensate can drip into the cleanroom and create a risk of microbial contamination.

blocks.zh: 你的潔淨室相對濕度設定為多少？如果外部空氣濕度為 85% RH，HVAC 系統如何將它降到設定值？
blocks.en: What is the relative humidity set point of your cleanrooms? If the outdoor air humidity is 85% RH, how does the HVAC system bring it down to the set point?

blocks.zh: 露點控制不當可能導致什麼 GMP 問題？如何預防？
blocks.en: What GMP problems can improper dew point control cause? How can they be prevented?

blocks.zh: 1.6.24 Life Cycle Cost Approach（生命週期成本法）
blocks.en: 1.6.24 Life Cycle Cost Approach

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TCO 思維 (Total Cost of Ownership)
blocks.en: Key Concept: TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) Thinking

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統的生命週期成本通常遠大於初始建造成本。一般而言：
blocks.en: The life cycle cost of an HVAC system is usually far greater than the initial construction cost. In general:

blocks.zh: 初始資本支出 (CAPEX)：約占 30-40%
blocks.en: Initial capital expenditure (CAPEX): about 30-40%

blocks.zh: 運營成本 (OPEX，含能源、維護、備件)：約占 60-70%
blocks.en: Operating expenditure (OPEX, including energy, maintenance and spare parts): about 60-70%

blocks.zh: 最便宜的 HVAC 系統不一定是初始成本最低的——而是整個生命週期（通常 15-25 年）中總花費最低的。
blocks.en: The cheapest HVAC system is not necessarily the one with the lowest initial cost, but the one with the lowest total spend over the whole life cycle (usually 15-25 years).

blocks.zh: 這就像買車的總擁有成本 (TCO)——買一輛便宜但油耗高的車，10 年下來的總花費可能比買一輛貴但省油的車更多。HVAC 系統也一樣：一台高效率但較貴的 AHU，長期的能源節省可能遠超過初始多付的錢。
blocks.en: This is like the total cost of ownership (TCO) of a car: buying a cheap but fuel-hungry car may cost more over 10 years than buying an expensive but fuel-efficient one. HVAC systems are the same: for a more expensive high-efficiency AHU, the long-term energy savings may far exceed the extra money paid up front.

blocks.zh: HVAC 故障的間接成本可能是天文數字：
blocks.en: The indirect costs of HVAC failure can be astronomical:

blocks.zh: 一批無菌產品因環境失控被廢棄 = 數百萬到數千萬元損失
blocks.en: A sterile product batch scrapped because of loss of environmental control = losses of millions to tens of millions

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗室因溫度失控導致數據無效 = 可能延誤產品上市數月
blocks.en: A stability chamber losing temperature control and invalidating data = possible delay of months in product launch

blocks.zh: 生產停機 = 客戶交期延誤、CDMO 信譽損失
blocks.en: Production downtime = delayed client deliveries and damage to the CDMO's reputation

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼冗餘 AHU 和備用元件的投資雖然看似「過度」，但從風險角度可能完全合理。
blocks.en: This is why investment in redundant AHUs and spare components, although it may look "excessive", can be entirely reasonable from a risk perspective.

blocks.zh: 你的設施曾經因為 HVAC 故障損失過批次嗎？損失金額大約是多少？
blocks.en: Has your facility ever lost a batch because of an HVAC failure? Roughly how much was the loss?

blocks.zh: 如果 HVAC 系統需要更新，你會如何向管理層呈報 TCO 分析來爭取預算？
blocks.en: If the HVAC system needs to be renewed, how would you present a TCO analysis to management to secure the budget?

blocks.zh: 1.6.25 Sustainability（永續發展）
blocks.en: 1.6.25 Sustainability

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 與 ESG
blocks.en: Key Concept: HVAC and ESG

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統佔製藥設施能耗的最大比例，因此是永續發展 (Sustainability) 和 ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) 策略的核心焦點。隨著全球碳排放法規趨嚴，「綠色 HVAC」正從「加分項」變成「必要項」。
blocks.en: HVAC systems account for the largest share of energy consumption in pharmaceutical facilities, making them a core focus of sustainability and ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) strategy. As global carbon emission regulations tighten, "green HVAC" is moving from a "nice-to-have" to a "must-have".

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，綠色設施認證（如 LEED、BREEAM）可以成為市場差異化的工具——越來越多的跨國製藥公司在選擇 CDMO 合作夥伴時，會將永續發展績效納入評估標準。投資節能 HVAC 系統不僅降低運營成本，還能提升市場競爭力。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, green building certification (such as LEED or BREEAM) can be a market differentiation tool: more and more multinational pharmaceutical companies include sustainability performance in their criteria when choosing a CDMO partner. Investing in energy-efficient HVAC systems not only lowers operating costs but also improves market competitiveness.

blocks.zh: 你的設施有沒有永續發展或節能目標？HVAC 系統在其中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: Does your facility have sustainability or energy-saving targets? What role does the HVAC system play in them?

blocks.zh: 在不降低 GMP 合規性的前提下，有哪些 HVAC 節能措施可以實施？
blocks.en: Which HVAC energy-saving measures can be implemented without reducing GMP compliance?

blocks.zh: 1.6.26 Key Terms（關鍵術語）
blocks.en: 1.6.26 Key Terms

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 必備術語表
blocks.en: Key Concept: Essential HVAC Glossary

blocks.zh: 以下是本節定義的關鍵術語，務必理解：
blocks.en: Below are the key terms defined in this section, which you must understand:

blocks.zh: 風量 (Air Flow)：單位時間通過風管或空間的空氣體積（如 CFM 或 m3/h）
blocks.en: Air flow: the volume of air passing through a duct or space per unit time (such as CFM or m3/h)

blocks.zh: 換氣次數 (Air Change Rate)：每小時進入房間的空氣體積 / 房間總體積。如 1000 CFM 送入 1000 ft3 的房間 = 60 次/hr
blocks.en: Air change rate: the volume of air entering the room per hour / the total volume of the room. For example, 1000 CFM supplied to a 1000 ft3 room = 60 per hr

blocks.zh: 靜壓 (Static Pressure)：各方向均等施加的壓力，代表流體系統的位能
blocks.en: Static pressure: pressure exerted equally in all directions, representing the potential energy of a fluid system

blocks.zh: 動壓 (Velocity Pressure)：因流速而產生的單向壓力，代表動能
blocks.en: Velocity pressure: unidirectional pressure produced by flow velocity, representing kinetic energy

blocks.zh: 全壓 (Total Pressure)：靜壓 + 動壓
blocks.en: Total pressure: static pressure + velocity pressure

blocks.zh: 壓差 (DP)：兩個空間之間的靜壓差，驅動縫隙處的氣流方向
blocks.en: Differential pressure (DP): the static pressure difference between two spaces, which drives the direction of airflow at gaps

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
換氣次數計算範例:
  送風量: 1000 CFM
  房間體積: 10 ft × 10 ft × 10 ft = 1000 ft³

  ACR = (1000 CFM × 60 min/hr) / 1000 ft³
      = 60,000 ft³/hr / 1000 ft³
      = 60 次/hr (ac/hr)

壓力關係:
  全壓 (TP) = 靜壓 (SP) + 動壓 (VP)
blocks.en:
Air change rate calculation example:
  Supply airflow: 1000 CFM
  Room volume: 10 ft × 10 ft × 10 ft = 1000 ft³

  ACR = (1000 CFM × 60 min/hr) / 1000 ft³
      = 60,000 ft³/hr / 1000 ft³
      = 60 per hr (ac/hr)

Pressure relationship:
  Total pressure (TP) = static pressure (SP) + velocity pressure (VP)

blocks.zh: 道爾頓分壓定律 (Dalton's Law) 的 HVAC 應用特別有趣：即使一個房間的空氣壓力比外界高（正壓），水蒸氣的分壓可能比外界低（因為房間被除濕了）。結果是：水蒸氣會從外界滲入高壓房間！這解釋了為什麼即使有正壓保護，高濕度地區的潔淨室仍然會有濕度控制問題。
blocks.en: The HVAC application of Dalton's Law of partial pressures is especially interesting: even if a room's air pressure is higher than the outside (positive pressure), the partial pressure of water vapor may be lower than outside (because the room has been dehumidified). The result is that water vapor can seep from the outside into the higher-pressure room! This explains why cleanrooms in high-humidity regions can still have humidity control problems even with positive-pressure protection.

blocks.zh: 計算你的主要潔淨室的換氣次數：已知送風量和房間尺寸，ACR 是多少？

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: HVAC 是製藥設施的關鍵系統——直接影響產品品質、人員安全和環境保護。設計需要 GEP + GMP 兩者兼顧。
blocks.en: HVAC is a critical system in pharmaceutical facilities, directly affecting product quality, personnel safety and environmental protection. The design needs to satisfy both GEP and GMP.

blocks.zh: 空氣品質控制的三大手段：過濾 (Filtration)、壓差 (DP)、換氣次數 (Air Change Rate)——缺一不可。
blocks.en: The three means of air quality control: filtration, differential pressure (DP) and air change rate; none can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 換氣次數 ≠ 潔淨度等級——換氣次數更多地決定 Recovery Rate（恢復速度），而非直接決定微粒計數。武斷設定的換氣次數可能過度設計。
blocks.en: Air change rate ≠ cleanliness class: the air change rate mainly determines the recovery rate rather than directly determining particle counts. An arbitrarily set air change rate may lead to over-design.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室分級體系：EU Grade (A/B/C/D) vs FDA ISO (5/7/8) vs ISPE Grade (5/7/8)——ISPE 提供橋接術語。EU 同時要求 at-rest 和 in-operation 限度。
blocks.en: Cleanroom classification systems: EU Grade (A/B/C/D) vs FDA ISO (5/7/8) vs ISPE Grade (5/7/8); ISPE provides bridging terminology. The EU requires both at-rest and in-operation limits.

blocks.zh: 人員是最大的活性微粒來源——舒適的操作員每分鐘釋放 10 萬個微粒，不舒適時可達數百萬個。溫度控制 = 污染源控制。
blocks.en: People are the biggest source of viable particles: a comfortable operator sheds 100,000 particles per minute, and up to millions when uncomfortable. Temperature control = contamination source control.

blocks.zh: 區分「必要」和「可選」的 HVAC 規格——產品導向 (GMP 要求) vs 商業導向 (Discretionary)。避免過度設計。
blocks.en: Distinguish "necessary" from "optional" HVAC specifications: product-driven (GMP requirement) vs business-driven (discretionary). Avoid over-design.

blocks.zh: 氣閘三種類型：串級式 (Cascade)、氣泡式 (Bubble)、沉降式 (Sink)——選擇取決於保護對象（產品 vs 人員 vs 兩者）。
blocks.en: Three airlock types: cascade, bubble and sink; the choice depends on what is being protected (product vs personnel vs both).

blocks.zh: 壓差建議值：不同等級之間 10-15 Pa，自動控制非 GMP 要求但為良好實務。
blocks.en: Recommended differential pressure: 10-15 Pa between different grades; automated control is not a GMP requirement but is good practice.

blocks.zh: 生命週期成本 (TCO) 通常遠大於初始資本成本——HVAC 故障的間接成本（批次損失、交期延誤）可能是天文數字。
blocks.en: Life cycle cost (TCO) is usually far greater than the initial capital cost; the indirect costs of HVAC failure (batch loss, delivery delays) can be astronomical.

blocks.zh: 永續發展趨勢：綠色 HVAC 正從「加分項」變成「必要項」，是 CDMO 市場差異化的工具。
blocks.en: Sustainability trend: green HVAC is moving from a "nice-to-have" to a "must-have" and is a market differentiation tool for CDMOs.
